title: Existence of exact singleton realizations and normalized comparisons
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a scheme $S$ on which $\ell$ is invertible, and $n\geq0$. For every projective-line presentation $p$, maps $d$, and etale-origin comparison record $h$ [lem-sp-tower-p1-etale-origin-comparisons], there exists SingleLevelComparisons [def-sp-tower-p1-single-level-data] at the finite ring $B_{n+1}$, whose finiteness is supplied by $p$. This asserts only existence of exact zero-off-n embeddings and their canonical normalized operation comparisons, with no assertion of finite or tower triangle identities.

source.place: Levels, single-level realization and evaluation of the finite triangle words

proof.text:
For a sheaf $N$ of $B_n$-modules on $T_{\mathrm{proet}}$, define $s_{n,T}N$ by $(s_{n,T}N)_n=N$, $(s_{n,T}N)_m=0$ for $m
e n$, and all adjacent transitions zero. Every transition is semilinear: both $t_m(ax)$ and $ ar a\,t_m(x)$ are zero. Send a module map to that map in level $n$ and zero in all other levels. The transition squares commute, and identities and compositions are componentwise by [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers]. Kernels and cokernels in the tower category are componentwise by [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian], so $s_{n,T}$ is additive and exact. Moreover $e_ns_{n,T}=1$, and $e_ms_{n,T}=0$ for $m
e n$. For comparison inverse image, [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism] gives its action on the underlying sheaf and every scalar operation. Exactness on abelian sheaves is [lem-weil-pbc-site-pullback-abelian-exact]; module kernels and cokernels carry the induced scalar actions and have the underlying abelian kernels and cokernels, so this also proves exactness of $
u_T^*$ on $B_n$-module sheaves.

source.place: Levels, final paragraph; single-level test objects for the finite triangle identities

proof.text:
Apply [lem-sf-exact-functor-derived-triangulated] to the exact composite $s_{n,T}
u_T^*$. Its termwise application defines the exact derived functor $J_{n,T}$. Exactness carries quasi-isomorphisms to quasi-isomorphisms, so the construction is independent of representatives and acts on derived morphisms, not only on objects. On a representative $L^ ullet$, its cohomology is $
u_T^*H^r(L^ ullet)$ at level $n$ and zero elsewhere, because both functors preserve kernels and cokernels. Thus a lower cohomological bound for $L$ is also one for $J_{n,T}L$. The equalities $e_nJ_{n,T}=
u_T^*$ and $e_mJ_{n,T}=0$ for $m
e n$ follow termwise. The witness at $n$ is $(L,1)$ and at $m
e n$ is $(0,1)$ in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness]. Consequently the image lies in $\mathscr C^+(T)$.

source.place: Tag 015F, lemma-right-derived-exact-functor, applied to the exact singleton functor

proof.text:
Use [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections] for the natural comparisons $e_nF\simeq Rq_{*,B_n}e_n$ on pro-etale categories and $e_nq_ ullet^*=q^{-1}e_n$, and for compatibility with tensor, composition and the specified adjunction-mate maps. Apply [lem-sp-tower-p1-etale-origin-comparisons] to pass, on etale-origin levels, to the corresponding ordinary etale operations through the specified comparison mate. Substituting $e_nJ_{n,P}=
u_P^*$ and $e_nJ_{n,S}=
u_S^*$ yields natural isomorphisms $a_L:e_nFJ_{n,P}L\simeq
u_S^*F_nL$ and $b_H:e_nGJ_{n,S}H\simeq
u_P^*G_nH$. Twists and the shift $[2]$ are included in that cited compatibility. The cited comparison lemma also says that $F,G$ preserve the displayed bounded-below etale-origin domains. Hence it applies again to $FJ_{n,P}L$, $GJ_{n,S}H$ and their iterates. Compose its natural comparisons to obtain those for $FG$ and $GF$. This uses only the level witnesses just constructed, not a compatible choice of etale representatives for a general tower; the cited lemma imposes no finite-Tor hypothesis.
